{{Top|leg}}
A '''Repulsorlift handtruck''' was a small platform levitated by miniature [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsor]] clusters and guided by a handle. To stabilize the load, a [[Repulsor-compensator|compensator]] adjusted the repulsor outputs in direct proportion to the cargo weight.
